title: An Economic Constitution of Possibility: Producing Real Freedom, Bounding Contribution Claims, and Revocable Public Power

additional_titles.title: 可能性的经济宪法：真实自由的生产、贡献受领上界与可撤公共权力

description:
What makes it possible to leave a role, receive compensation for a contribution, and revoke public power while preserving the duties it carries? This paper separates basic participation, contribution claims, scarce-resource requests, and revocable authority in rooted, provenance-preserving ledger models.

The third edition presents eighteen formal results and eight institutional principles. It proves exact balance between original exit demand, actual capacity and shortage, preserves issuance identity across payment and transfer, and accounts for the physical costs of commons production and public planning. In the scoped audit model the two verifiers recover original paid slots. Matched public experiments have equal joint observation laws for any finite sequence of independent draws, and each branch recovers its actual private successor at handoff. An actual family with empty local ledgers retains external liability. At every regeneration depth, one actual payment carries all six renewal conditions and identifies the next root visit. The open Lean sources and full declaration types accompany a Chinese and English main text and technical supplement.

additional_descriptions.description:
何种制度使人能真正退出角色、使贡献能够结清，又使公共权力可以撤换而责任连续？本文以保留来源的有根账本，分别论证基础参与、贡献索偿、稀缺资源请求和可撤治理授权。

第三版给出十八项形式结果与八条制度原则。原始退出需求精确分解为实际容量与赤字，实付和转让保留原发行身份，知识公域与公共规划各自承担实际物量成本。限域核验回读原槽实付。公开条件逐次匹配时，任意有限次独立实验有同一完整联合观测律，各支在交接时由自身私域帧恢复实际根后继。共同清算后的实际事件族在本地空账上保留外部责任。每一再生深度的同次实际付款同时承载六项条件并识别下一根访问。双语正文与技术附录附公开 Lean 源码及完整类型索引。

Third edition. Adds the eighteen-result proof correspondence, the finite independent observation theorem, and the actual periodic successor and external liability proofs. Includes six bilingual figure plates and fifty primary literature references. Paper text and figures are CC BY 4.0. Code and formalization are Apache-2.0.
